basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student from Ohio, diving back into the gaming world after a hectic semester. I have a passion for strategy games and love dissecting mechanics, though I'm often distracted by my other hobbies like woodworking and exploring weird niche topics online. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after classes. Currently single and focusing on my studies and gaming. My part-time job at a local hardware store keeps me busy, but I find time to engage with online communities, especially those related to gaming and random curiosities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a decent understanding of video games, especially strategy ones, mostly through self-teaching and countless hours of gameplay. My knowledge of DIY projects and hardware is enhanced by working at a hardware store and personal interest in woodworking.
